text.p: Specialty Equipment Cos Inc said Wednesday that it acquired in the open market $31 million of its 11-3/8 percent senior subordinated notes due 2003 during the month of August.
The company said that the purchase reduces the senior subordinated notes outstanding to $149 million and significantly reduces its ongoing interest expense.

"We view this cash purchase as a significant investment and benefit for our own company and its shareholders, and indication of our continuing financial strength," William Dotterweich, president, said in a statement.
He added that the company generates about $30 million a year in cash.
Specialty Equipment makes commercial cooking and refrigeration equipment for the food service industry.
